description: List published Flamel blog posts, newest first. Optionally filter by category. Returns titles, URLs, summaries, and publish dates, not full bodies.

category.description: Category name, e.g. "Social Media", "Strategy", "Paid Advertising", "AI & Automation". Omit for all categories.

limit.description: How many posts to return (1-50). Defaults to 10.

page.description: Page number for pagination. Defaults to 1.

name: list_blog_posts
title: List blog posts
